chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Whoever fasts one day voluntarily, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will admit him to Paradise."
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting one voluntary day in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great reward for voluntary fasting, even for a single day. It presents such fasting as an act of worship that earns Allah’s mercy and entry into Paradise.
